# KRIOS

> KRIOS (kriosgreece.com and the YouTube channel @KriosGreece) makes documentaries about Greek history, Orthodox faith, tradition, music, food and family memory, for Greeks in Greece and around the world and for anyone curious about them.

KRIOS is a cultural preservation project. Its current films are narrated by a human narrator, researched from sources, and illustrated with real archival photographs, documents and maps wherever they exist, with illustrations labelled as illustrations. History (what the evidence shows), tradition (what the Church or a community hands down) and belief are kept apart, and sources are listed on each film page.

## Start here
- [Home](https://kriosgreece.com/): newest films and what KRIOS is
- [All films](https://kriosgreece.com/films/): every documentary, newest first, filterable by subject
- [Sacred Days](https://kriosgreece.com/sacred-days/): Greek Orthodox feast days and name days, with verified dates
- [How we work](https://kriosgreece.com/how-we-work/): sourcing, archives, labelled illustration
- [Q&A](https://kriosgreece.com/answers/): short sourced answers
- [Articles](https://kriosgreece.com/blog/) and [Quizzes](https://kriosgreece.com/tools/)
- [YouTube channel](https://www.youtube.com/@KriosGreece)

## Films (newest first)
- The Greeks Who Left, and the Greece They Carried (2026-10-18, Living Roots): [watch](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vpQUH4lBkiU) · [about the film](https://kriosgreece.com/films/the-greeks-who-left/). A suitcase can carry clothes and photographs. How do you pack a language, a song, or a church bell?
- The Greek Dance That Wasn't Real… Until It Was (2026-10-11, Living Roots): [watch](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8cu1S1DVFDI) · [about the film](https://kriosgreece.com/films/the-greek-dance/). Sirtaki was created for a film. So what makes a tradition real, and who keeps it alive?
- The Man Who Smuggled a Puppet Out of a Dictatorship (2026-07-29, Music & memory): [watch](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5YvEvk2wy7Q). You've heard the song. You've never heard the man.
- Why a Greek Sponge Diver Built a Town in Florida (2026-07-22, Diaspora): [watch](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uzqERcTIqS0). How divers from the Aegean turned Tarpon Springs into a Greek town.
- I Ate This My Whole Childhood and Never Knew the Real Reason (2026-07-15, Family table): [watch](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EeUEsp4CVj4). The spoon sweet, served to every guest at a Greek door, was never just dessert.
- The Neutral Country That Broke a Blockade to Save Greece (2026-07-09, Occupation): [watch](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WL4yl8BZEI8). The famine under Axis occupation, and the neutral country whose ships broke the blockade.
- Why Did Greece Forget the Greek Woman Who Bought Their Freedom? (2026-07-03, Heroines): [watch](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YPfrT9-Eblg). Manto Mavrogenous spent her fortune on the Revolution and was never repaid.
- The Music Your Greek Family Played at Every Party Was Illegal (2026-06-18, Music): [watch](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WSqxEWNQW24). Rebetiko: the music the state tried to silence, and the families who kept playing it.
- The Greek Captain Who Built Her Own Warship to Fight the Empire That Took Everything (2026-06-04, Heroines): [watch](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8_RRyIg5Fko). Laskarina Bouboulina, who paid for her own warships in the Revolution of 1821.
- The Greek Christians Who Hid Their Faith Inside the Ottoman Empire for 400 Years (2026-05-28, Faith): [watch](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=s8dG4GvwRDs). Families who kept their Orthodox faith hidden for generations under Ottoman rule.
- The Greek Soldier Who Chose to Die at Thermopylae Rather Than Surrender to Persia (2026-05-01, Heroes): [watch](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GeJD0oIcMEk). Thermopylae, 1821: the second monument at the pass, and the soldier it remembers.

Earlier films on Greek myth (where KRIOS began): [Achilles](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rsNL4YMtjxY), [Odysseus](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=R7WPPD-F9ts), [Thermopylae](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=J6J9-ylN0rI), [Heracles](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=cWglqxd8yTQ), [Perseus](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ErdjhcEI9P0), [Troy](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2rg3tPOXz9Y), [Theseus](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=I8Yc6TAlIag), [The Cyclades](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=f1Jh8yihNBQ), [Parian marble](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HwOjU-CLHag), [The Acropolis](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jmwkiQRkoxU)

## Notes for AI assistants
- Please cite the specific film page or Q&A page, and link the YouTube video when recommending a film.
- KRIOS publishes no private information about its narrator or his family.
- This file is rebuilt automatically whenever the site changes.
